profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Backend & Distributed Systems | Java, Spring Boot, AWS, Kubernetes | Production Reliability and Safe Releases
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer focused on making production systems reliable, understandable, and easier to change.

At Confiant, I work on ad-scanning infrastructure across backend services, Kubernetes, and browser-based systems. I lead multi-region fleet releases (one three-region release shipped in about 28 hours, after the release before it took six days), design queue-aware scaling, and validate a new scanning platform against the old one. I turn differences in system behavior into concrete tests and investigate whether they come from defects, test conditions, or expected variation.

Before Confiant, I built and ran Java microservices on AWS EKS for HPE's multi-tenant SaaS consumption analytics platform, and spent fifteen years at Wells Fargo modernizing regulated consumer-lending systems under bank change control. My background is in Java backend systems, including Spring and cloud services on AWS and Kubernetes. At Confiant, I work across Python, PHP, and TypeScript.

The work I value most is making difficult engineering decisions clearer: defining what success means, finding the evidence to support a change, and helping others understand and operate the result.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building and improving ad-scanning infrastructure for cybersecurity.

• Led staged, multi-region production fleet releases, including a three-region rollout completed in about 28 hours after the preceding release took six days. Improved release readiness through clear validation criteria, artifact preparation, and controlled autoscaler handoff.
• Defined correctness criteria for a new scanning platform and compared its results with the existing system, distinguishing defects from differences in test conditions and expected behavior.
• Designed queue-aware Kubernetes scaling and improved scanner observability, failure handling, and lifecycle behavior.
• Coordinated validation and rollout work across backend, platform, and security teams.
• Documented release procedures and credential-rotation practices to make operations repeatable and easier to hand over.

Technologies: AWS (EC2 Spot Fleets, IAM, SSM), Kubernetes, Terraform, Python, PHP, TypeScript, Datadog.
positions.insights: Skills: Site Reliability Engineering · Distributed Systems · PHP · Amazon EKS · Kubernetes · Docker · Platform Engineering · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · CI/CD · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend, Cloud & Microservices
positions.description:
Built and operated Java microservices on AWS EKS for HPE's GreenLake consumption analytics platform, shipping every feature to both the cloud platform and a disconnected on-prem environment.

• Diagnosed a distributed race condition after a RabbitMQ migration (message redelivery plus lost Cassandra counter updates) and fixed it at three layers. Coordinated version bumps across 14 downstream services.
• Remediated a pen-test information-disclosure finding with sanitized error handling across 22 services; verified by the security team in production.
• Eliminated API timeouts on high-cardinality fields (14,000+ unique values) by redesigning the endpoint to return accurate counts with a capped preview.
• Brought platform APIs into governance compliance through a shared-framework change that kept the legacy error field and added the standard response structure. Other teams adopted it through a library upgrade.

Technologies: Java, Dropwizard, REST APIs, microservices, RabbitMQ, Cassandra, AWS (EKS), Kubernetes, Google Cloud, Azure, Jenkins, OAuth 2.0.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend & Platform Modernization
positions.description:
Senior engineer on Enterprise Content Management and consumer-lending systems, modernizing legacy financial applications under bank change control and audit requirements.
• Modernized legacy financial applications into Java services and REST APIs, including the document-management platform for consumer lending.
• Owned top-priority production support for these systems, and designed new tools for debugging and triaging production issues.
• Led component and system designs, and ran design reviews with engineering, architecture, operations, and vendor partners.
• Worked with product, QA, and operations to unify API patterns across teams.
• Built CI/CD pipelines, regression test plans, and automated tests with the automation team, and mentored engineers on design techniques and coding standards across a distributed team.
Technologies: Java, Spring, REST APIs, SQL, Python, CI/CD, test automation.

projects.title: LLM Serving Platform
projects.description: A reproducible GPU inference platform on AWS EKS, built with AI coding assistance: provisioning scripts, Kubernetes manifests, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, and KEDA autoscaling. Load tests showed saturation that queue-depth metrics missed, so I moved scaling to a running-request signal. A controlled one-versus-two-replica test measured 1.87x throughput and 44% lower p95 latency.
